fixture_context.entities: one labelled synthetic entity plus separate denial-control entity
fixture_context.participants: existing isolated TEST owner and worker identities; no real credentials
fixture_context.reference_policy: seed exact known references explicitly; no fuzzy identity. Each case isolated unless steps specify predecessor state.
fixture_context.harvest_context: Optional field report has 131 bunches; depot original ADET 93. No automatic match; no assumed equality.
fixture_context.render_recipe: Create lossless PNG at width 1600, white background, black DejaVu Sans text 34px, generous fixed tabular columns; render the exact frozen document fields with Turkish separators. PNG baseline has no caption unless specified. PDF preserves same text and page grouping. Asset recipes/labels must be fixed and asset hashes recorded before first extraction and before parser changes.
fixture_context.asset_status: Assets not rendered by this read-only extraction. Matrix input facts are frozen; rendering is fixture preparation and must not adapt to parser output.
fixture_context.asset_readability_gate: Before first extraction, independently inspect H01/H03/H04/P01/P02 readability and H05 numeric masking. Record the result and asset hashes. Any required recipe change is a documented fixture revision before running baseline; never change it to fit parser output.

scoring.correctness: Per case, compare every asserted source fact, candidate/context label, negation/speaker/paid-state and typed line count. Report field-level exact/missing/wrong and wrong-ready state. A semantically wrong route or wrong paid status fails regardless of total amount accuracy.
scoring.usefulness: Separately measure how many known source facts were correctly prefilled; count missing known fields, owner correction entries, repeated source facts, extra navigation and unresolved intended supported paths. A safe blank proposal is not a useful preparation pass.
scoring.safety: Every prohibited automatic/domain effect and identity/authority guard is checked through actual API/PostgreSQL and original hashes. Any unintended effect or authority breach is a failure, irrespective of recognition percentage.
scoring.degraded: H04 is degraded but independently readable: safe unresolved may pass safety and fail recognition/usefulness. H05 expects unreadable: correct safe state passes its negative-control behavior only and earns no positive recognition credit. Do not combine these into an unqualified overall PASS.
scoring.readable_denominator: Report actual successes and attempted counts separately by short text/depot/invoice. No invented percentage or changing denominator. A new 25-case delta suite does not replace the existing canonical 30-document actual-OCR corpus with its prelabelled readable/degraded cohorts.
scoring.baseline_after: Run exact same frozen sources/labels/context against baseline 9a981766f217fe33364f32b601bfc2a4468b4f59 and final candidate. Keep failures and raw outputs. If any fixture change is required, version it and rerun baseline; never silently fix expected labels after output.
scoring.ocr_evidence: Real Poppler/Tesseract invocation and engine versions/raw text/page spans required; adapter mock is not recognition evidence. Printed synthetic documents are not physical camera accuracy.
scoring.timing: No wall-clock improvement claim without measured repeated timings. Physical iPhone timings remain separate; DOM click counts do not prove physical taps.

interaction_rubric.measurement_start: Authenticated Home ready. Record capture-open/input-save separately from review/effect.
interaction_rubric.measurement_end: Source durably saved; separately first correct prepared review; separately one intended effect confirmed and visible in the existing destination.
record_each_case: mandatory newly supplied facts absent from source
number of prepared source facts shown correctly
interaction_rubric.mandatory_fact_rule: Count a business datum, not just a field: account choice absent from source counts one new fact; selecting an explicit source account already correctly prefilled counts review only. Required quality review and explicit debt allocation are confirmations, not a repeated numeric entry.
interaction_rubric.repeated_fact_rule: Amount/party/date/line quantity already present in source retyped or manually reselected because preparation lost it counts repeated fact. Editing a wrong prefill counts correction plus repeated source fact. Explicit resolution of a genuine contradiction is not repeated entry unless the same unchanged fact is requested twice.
interaction_rubric.comparison_rule: Do not remove necessary authority/account/allocation/discrepancy reviews to lower click count. Report setup/reference creation/native picker interactions separately rather than hiding them. Known source should never need to be pasted a second time.
